shortDescription: Adds the native Anomaly psychic ritual Blahaj Awakening, sacrificing a humanlike pawn to create the Blåhaj resurrector serum; poor ritual quality comas the invoker.
body:
## Blahaj Awakening Anomaly psychic ritual

Adds `OMW_BlahajAwakening` as an Anomaly `PsychicRitualDef`, independent of Ideology ritual precepts. It is gated by `BasicPsychicRituals`, and its def requires both the Anomaly DLC and `oldmanwhistler.BlahajPlush`. The ritual uses the Psychic Ritual Spot and vanilla invocation-circle presentation, with one invoker, optional standard chanters, and one humanlike sacrifice target. Its sole required offering is exactly one `OMW_BlahajPlushApparel` Blåhaj plush; no shard is required or consumed.

On success the victim is killed, its corpse is immediately set to dessicated and destroyed, and one `OMW_ResurrectorBlahajSerum` is spawned at the ritual location. Coma duration is interpolated linearly from 8 hours at zero quality to none at maximum quality using a `PsychicComa` hediff whose disappearance timer is set in ticks.

## Existing mod features

Retains the six IKEA Storageborn body genes and categories, Swedish naming rule packs, Blåhaj Blast and RainMaker abilities, Flatpack pawn-generation item, and the Blåhaj resurrector serum with its custom resurrection flow and optional Anomaly ritual visuals/audio.
